data_fields.name: cost_levels
data_fields.donor_constant: 27 steps; step L at skill_cost_needed(L) = exp_needed(L,1) * 13 total XP

data_fields.name: points_to_level_base
data_fields.donor_constant: 25*L*(L+1); plus half of 25*(L-b)*(L-b+1) for each breakpoint b in {9,18,26} below L

best_idea: A fixed 100-event recent-use queue sets each skill's share of one XP pool, so what the player does decides where the XP goes, under one global cost curve.
decision_why: Frankendom needs a use-based tilt on one XP ledger; the queue gives that without a per-skill XP bar. Adapt: keep the queue-to-weights split and the global cost ladder, change phase 2 to a seeded server pick and fix the rounding order (ascending to descending) because kills and XP are server-verified and must replay.
acceptance: Server test: fixed queue of 75 sword and 25 dodge events, 1,000 XP award at 10 XP per point gives sword 75 points and dodge 25 points (within one point); the same seed repeats the same split.
